comments.author: relic
comments.story: Google Maps is filled with false business addresses pretending to be nearby
comments.why: Speaker exploited fake Maps listings to intercept Secret Service calls.
comments.text: I happened on a YouTube video of a TedX talk where a guy is really into this Google Maps scam. He got to the point where he was able to impersonate the US Secret Service and recorded a bunch of phone calls. The Secret Service told google to fix their maps issue, but he said they just disabled some features and reactived them without change a few weeks later. [VIDEO]
